MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper feels like a useful next purchase because it would help me measure and match screws, washers, and shafts when using my fastener assortments.",
    "The metric screw kit and neodymium magnets connect to my recent fastener and magnetic hook purchases, so they reflect some of my interests even though I would skip them today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors and heat shrink tubing require a wiring project I have not indicated; buying mechanical fasteners does not mean I currently need electrical repair supplies.",
    "The test kit, printer filament, and electronic cleaner do not serve a need suggested by my recent purchases.",
    "Another screw assortment would duplicate a recent purchase, while bare disc magnets do not provide the ready-to-use hanging function that attracted me to magnetic hooks."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in workshop hardware seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any repair or maintenance supply.",
    "Magnets and screws seem to have been treated as sufficient matches without considering their function or whether I already bought something similar."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A tool that helps me use my recent purchases, such as measuring fastener dimensions, is more useful now than another large assortment.",
    "My magnetic hook purchases suggest an interest in convenient mounting and hanging, rather than magnets in every form.",
    "I rarely interact unless something addresses a concrete need, so a broad connection to DIY work is not enough for me to choose it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in fasteners and magnetic mounting but extended it too broadly beyond practical complements to my recent purchases."
}
